name: Odico A/S
summary: Odico A/S specializes in the production and distribution of formwork systems for both the building sector and the wind energy industry. Beyond its core manufacturing, the company provides a suite of expert advisory services, including design guidance, verification, sophisticated parametric modeling, project oversight, engineering support, prototyping, and thorough testing. Established in 2012, the firm operates from its main office situated in Odense, Denmark.
